failures.symptom: The Git materialized binary fixture did not match the declared SHA-256, so parser execution was skipped.
failures.root_cause: The first manually supplied base64 payload was not byte-identical to the locally generated fixture used to calculate the expected SHA-256.
failures.fix: Rematerialize the exact local fixture bytes. Correct Git blob SHA is 37598254803cb48569ecb3c754277a4c2a0df748 and the intended byte SHA-256 remains cc45d6d9511f68640442c736d05ccd625f34b634cd64115d34c3cf514d4890a4.
failures.regression_gate: CI must verify SHA-256 before parser execution; parser tests remain unreachable on a hash mismatch.
failures.boundary: Failed fixture materialization is not a parser failure.
